183##text.default: Cinematic prehistoric Jurassic landscape in ultra-realistic style, epic wide establishing shot at golden hour with soft volumetric god rays piercing through morning mist. A vast lush green valley with a winding turquoise river cutting through dense fern forests and palm trees, distant volcanic mountains smoking gently in the background under dramatic cloudy sky. Massive herds of long-necked sauropods (Brachiosaurus-like) gracefully walking and drinking from the river, smaller ceratopsians (Triceratops family) grazing on riverbank ferns, a group of armored ankylosaurs moving slowly. In the foreground, a powerful Tyrannosaurus Rex strides confidently toward the camera on the grassy slope, roaring subtly with jaws open, tail swaying, muscles rippling under textured skin. Above, flocks of pterosaurs (Pteranodon) soaring gracefully across the sky, wings catching sunlight. Gentle camera movement: slow dramatic push-in from wide landscape to focus on the T-Rex approaching, then slight pan following the river flow. Warm golden lighting, rich earthy tones, subtle dust particles in air, natural wind rustling leaves and ferns. Generate with immersive ambient soundtrack: distant dinosaur calls, river flowing, wind through trees, low rumbling volcano, occasional wing flaps. Photorealistic detail, National Geographic documentary style, 8K cinematic quality, smooth motion, high dynamic range.

Soft green willow branches sway in the gentle breeze, and pale pink peach blossoms fall slowly through the air. Soft cinematic lighting, volumetric light rays piercing through the gentle morning mist, ink-wash painting aesthetic, soft and muted color palette (celadon, soft peach, pale gold). Hyper-realistic, highly detailed. Smooth, slow camera pan from right to left, capturing the serene and poetic atmosphere.
